labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The IPv6DualStack feature gate for external cloud providers was removed, and users who still enable it manually must stop, which can break deployments that rely on it.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Pods with RestartPolicy=Always can now enter the Succeeded phase, so controllers that depended on that behavior may need to be adapted.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The in-tree AWS cloud provider and EBS storage plugin were removed, so users must migrate to the external cloud provider and CSI driver.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Requests setting the deprecated spec.externalID Node field now get a warning, but the field still works, so no action is required at this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Services now produce warnings for leading-zero IPv4 and non-canonical IPv6 addresses, which are warning-only and need no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The alpha seccomp annotations were removed and their fields are no longer auto-populated, so workloads must switch to securityContext.seccompProfile.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The SecurityContextDeny admission plugin is deprecated and still functions, so it is a future-removal notice with no action needed at this release.
